data.name: Tanner
data.gender_notes: Tanner is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'tan' meaning 'to prepare hides'. The name Tanner is a reflection of the strong and sturdy qualities of an individual who can work with leather and turn it into something functional and beautiful. The name Tanner carries the meaning “Tanner of hides” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Tanner usually hope their child will grow to embody tanner of hides and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tanner represents the transformation and evolution of raw materials into something valuable and useful. It symbolizes the strength and resilience needed to turn challenges into opportunities, and the creativity and innovation required to bring new ideas to life.
data.etymology: Tanner belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tanner of hides.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tanner total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.name: Τάννερ

in_latin.name: Tanner

in_english.name: Tanner

data.cultural_impact: The name Tanner carries a rich history and cultural significance. As a surname, Tanner represents a family's legacy of craftsmanship and skilled labor in tanning hides. Historically, leather working was an essential skill for survival, providing necessities like clothing, shelter, and tools. The name Tanner has remained a reminder of our industrious past and the importance of strong work ethics and practical skills.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Tanner can symbolize individual transformation and the art of cultivating resilience and strength. Like the tanning process turns raw hides into valuable goods, the name Tanner can serve as an inspiration to face the challenges of life with determination, perseverance, and the courage to grow from experiences. In a more metaphysical sense, it can also represents a calling to serve as a spiritual guide for others, helping them transform their own lives and thrive in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: A Tanner in Christian symbolism represents transformation and renewal. Just as a tanner processes raw hides into valuable leather, so too does faith transform ordinary lives into sacred vessels. This name invites us to embrace the ongoing process of spiritual growth and renewal.

historical_references.reference: Saint Tanner of Cartagena, also known as Tantalus of Tarragona, was a bishop in the late 4th and early 5th centuries. He is believed to have been the successor of Saint Felix I, the first bishop of Tarragona. Tanner is known for his role in the defense of Tarragona against the Visigoths in 411 AD. He was captured, but managed to escape and was later martyred.
historical_references.context: Defense of Tarragona against the Visigoths

historical_references.reference: Saint Tanner of Sens, also known as Tanarus, was a bishop in the 6th century. He is believed to have been a disciple of Saint Germain of Auxerre and was appointed bishop of Sens by King Childebert I in 511 AD. Tanner is known for his role in the spiritual development of the Merovingian dynasty and for his contributions to the early Christian art of Burgundy.
historical_references.context: Spiritual development of the Merovingian dynasty
